occurrences.context: A map of western New England and eastern New York drawn by Jonathan Edwards, c. 1751. Edwards apparently drew this map for Thomas Prince of Boston, a chronicler of New England history, who came to Stockbridge for a council in May 1751. The map records, among other things, the names of the ministers of some towns as well as several paths through Hampshire County. Courtesy Massachusetts Historical Society.
